unseen_covenant.name: The Unseen Covenant

honored: The shadows make room for you, sister-blade.
Walk soft, kin. You're one of us.
friendly: The Covenant sees you. Kindly, for once.
neutral: Keep your hands where I can see them.
wary: You're loud for someone so far from home.
Outsider. Mind the shadows — they mind you.
hostile: You should not have come back.

unseen_covenant.warn: Turn back, outsider. Duskhollow is not for your kind.
unseen_covenant.lore: The Covenant was the first to wake when the Root closed her eyes. They keep the Key of Shadows in a place that doesn't exist on maps.

lantern_choir.name: The Lantern Choir

honored: The dead sing your name gladly.
friendly: Be welcome. The echoes are calm today.
neutral: The dead are listening. Be polite.
wary: Your footsteps are too heavy here, stranger.
hostile: You have disturbed the dead once too often.

lantern_choir.warn: Lanternhome is a place of rest. Your kind brings noise. Turn back.
lantern_choir.lore: The Choir keeps the Key of Souls, and every song they sing is a memory someone forgot.

spiral_concordance.name: The Spiral Concordance

honored: Your theorems are cited in the lower floors.
friendly: Mind the floating stairs, they're shy.
neutral: Visitors sign the ledger. Visitors also don't touch anything.
wary: You are interrupting an experiment simply by existing.
hostile: You are a variable we intend to remove.

spiral_concordance.warn: Spireholm's inner circle is restricted. Turn back before the runes decide for you.
spiral_concordance.lore: The Concordance believes the dream has rules, and that rules can be rewritten. They keep the Key of Laws behind seven locks.

rootborn_hold.name: The Rootborn Hold

honored: We share our loam with you, kin.
neutral: Soft-skin. Step lightly on our roots.
wary: We do not like your smell, soft-skin.
hostile: We will make loam of you!

rootborn_hold.warn: Grrm. Gnarlhollow is for the Rootborn. Turn back, soft-skin, or be planted.
rootborn_hold.lore: The Hold guards the Key of Growth deep in the roots, where even sunlight has to ask permission.
